department: Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: The faculty page gives no closing date for applications for acceptance.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A professor in the faculty must agree to supervise you, and the supervision agreement goes with the application.
supervisor.quote: Zudem benötigen Sie eine/n Hochschullehrer/in der Fakultät Elektrotechnik und Informationstechnik, der/die sich bereit erklärt, die wissenschaftliche Betreuung Ihrer Promotion zu übernehmen

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: A good to very good university degree is needed, usually a Diploma or Master's with a research thesis.
entry_route.quote: in der Regel ein Diplom- oder Masterstudium mit einer wissenschaftlichen Abschlussarbeit
